text:
devon: Quick heads-up — we're bumping the release from v2.7.0 -> v2.7.1 to roll a fix for the KV cache TTL regression. Cut planned at 16:00 PT (~2h). Can folks help with a short CI blitz + flaky-test patrol? ping if you're taking ownership of any suite.

sarah: On it. I'll kick off targeted pipelines for unit + integration that touch cache code. tagging @ci-bot in case we need reruns. :thumbsup:

leo: I'll gate the merge queue — please don't merge non-essential PRs into release/* until we declare green.

kim: Do we have the changelog entry? I can add a line if someone drops the short blurb.

jen: I added a small bullet under "bugfixes" in CHANGELOG.md and bumped package.json in release branch. pushed to release/v2.7.1.

ci-bot: CI Started — pipeline: release-v2.7.1 (id: 5782). Jobs: build, lint, unit-tests, integration-tests, e2e-smoke. URL: https://ci.internal/runs/5782

devon: Thanks Jen. Sarah — if integration starts failing, can you capture the first failing job id and paste logs here? Suspect failing flakes around expiry tests.

sarah: Integration is running. Getting early failure in `TestKVExpiry` on node-local build 5782/integration/3. First failure snippet below:
```
--- FAIL: TestKVExpiry (0.64s)
    kv_test.go:132: expected key to expire after 5s, still present at 7s
    stack: github.com/redwood/inference/kv.(*Store).Get
```

sarah: Re-ran that job once, it passed. Will run the suite 3x to see rate.

devon: Sounds flaky. If it passes intermittently, mark it flaky and open a small follow-up PR to add jitter/timing margins. We shouldn't block release for a known instability unless repeatable.

leo: Agreed. If CI pass rate for that job < 80% over 5 runs, we'll block and rollback bump. Otherwise we continue and add a follow-up.

kim: I'll add a short note in the release ticket about the TTL regression + planned follow-up. Also adding a changelog blurb pointing to the ticket: INF-2048.

jen: FYI I ran `./scripts/ci rerun --job=integration --limit=3` for the failing matrix. Here's the command I used:
```
# rerun failing matrix jobs up to 3 times
./scripts/ci rerun --run-id=5782 --job=integration --limit=3
```

ci-bot: Rerun queued — 5782/rerun/1. Will post status in thread.

ci-bot: 5782/integration/3 rerun#1: PASS
ci-bot: 5782/integration/3 rerun#2: PASS

devon: Good. Looks like flake rate low for now. Action items: (1) leo holds the queue, (2) jen/changelog done, (3) sarah/jen collect any flakes and open small PRs, (4) kim document follow-up INF-2048.

leo: Queue hold in place. Merging paused until I post GO.

sarah: I'll run a quick targeted e2e smoke for KV flows once integrations finish.

jen: Quick request — can we bump the CI cache key to avoid stale artefacts? running `cache: bump: v2` locally. If everyone agrees I'll push a CI tweak to the release branch.

devon: Yes please. Bump the cache key, include note in the PR description. Avoid changing other unrelated CI behavior.

jen: Done and pushed -> release/ci-cache-bump-240120. PR: https://git.internal/rp/PR/4271 — description includes why (stale kv artefacts causing false negatives).

ci-bot: Build triggered for PR 4271 (id: 5783).

ci-bot: 5783/build: PASS, 5783/unit-tests: PASS, 5783/integration: PASS

devon: Nice — CI cache bump validated. If integration remains stable for next 15 minutes, I'll call the cut.

kim: LGTM. Adding release note: "Fix KV cache TTL causing intermittent stale reads — see INF-2048."

leo: Preparing to open merge window at +15m assuming no new fails.

sarah: Running final e2e smoke now. will report back in 5-10m.

ci-bot: 5782/e2e-smoke: PASS

devon: All good from my side. Calling the cut — merging release/v2.7.1 into main and kicking final deploy. Thanks everyone for the quick turn. :tada:

leo: Merged and unblocked queue. Great work. :raised_hands:

jen: I'll follow up with a small PR to add extra timing tolerance in TestKVExpiry and reference INF-2048.

sarah: Noted — will keep an eye on postdeploy metrics for cache miss patterns.

devon: Closing thread after deploy. If any regression pops up, tag #incidents and @oncall.

kim: :eyes: good job team.
